# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the [latest release](https://crates.io/crates/xsf) receives fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately through
[GitHub](https://github.com/jorenham/xsf-rust/security/advisories/new), and not in a public issue.

## Scope

This crate is pure Rust without `unsafe` code, I/O or network access. Wrong results, panics and
slow calls without a security impact belong in a regular
[issue](https://github.com/jorenham/xsf-rust/issues).
